verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation describing Unreal's PBR material system, GI/Lumen, shadowing, or post-processing pipeline; only indirect community remarks mention real-time ray-tracing-like lighting quality without RT hardware and 'beautiful lighting' in UE4. missing for 10: docs on PBR material workflow, GI/Lumen or baked lighting docs, shadow system docs, post-processing pipeline docs, independent benchmarks/screenshots corroborating renderer quality.
